_readme: Commissioner-only file. Set sleeperLeagueId once the league exists; until then the site runs on data/sample/.
name: The Blitz League
_rosterSlotsNote: The real Blitz League lineup, copied from Sleeper on 2026-11-04 (league 1423408541737156608). Bench 10, taxi 3, IR 4. In live mode the site uses Sleeper's own roster_positions instead of this list.
_playoffTeams: Top 6 by record, ties broken by points for. No byes (per the commissioner, 2026-11-04). In live mode Sleeper's settings.playoff_teams overrides this.
_gmIndexWeights: GM Index = weighted blend of each team's league-relative score (0-100) in win %, Lineup IQ and value from moves. GM of the Year itself is a league vote at season's end.
_trophyNote: Championship trophy from the commissioner, 2026-11-04. trophy = 640px web copy; championship-trophy-full.webp is the original 1024x1536.
_awardTrophiesNote: Offensive and Defensive Player of the Year trophies from the commissioner, 2026-11-04. 600px-tall web copies; *-full.webp are the originals.
_networkNote: The league's media brand (home-page news, and the 'Watch on' slot on every matchup). Branding from the commissioner, 2026-11-04. logo = full wordmark, mark = the BN square (stories with no team). The site uses the white-text versions (*-white.webp) because the navy originals vanish on the dark background; blitz-network.webp / blitz-network-mark.webp keep the original navy for light backgrounds, and *-src.* are the files as sent. logo null = a text wordmark shows instead. Stories go in data/news.json.
_prizesNote: Prize money, agreed by the commissioner 2026-11-04: $100 buy-in x 12 teams = $1,200. Ties split the prize evenly. Weekly = highest score of each regular-season week. Division winner = best record in the division, ties broken by points for (the site's standings rule). Points leader = most regular-season points for. GM of the Year = league vote. honorsOnly awards carry a trophy but no cash.
_divisionsNote: 2026-11-03: Iron District replaced Miracle City as the West. Colors were sampled from the division logos (navy #0B1F3F, gunmetal #3A4446). markOnDark tints the dark-ink marks so they show on the dark site.
_locationsNote: Candidate franchise locations from the 2026 planning brief (about 6 per region; 4 get picked). lat/lon are approximate city centers (Wyoming = state center). label = map label offset [dx, dy] in map units for crowded areas. A franchise claims one via franchises.json "location".
_inkNote: inkOnDark: the division color lifted for text, borders and map markers on the dark site. markOnDark: tint for dark-ink division marks (null = show the mark in its own colors).
